oracle_review_payload.body: U.S. Secretary of War Pete Haggett said the incident was still under investigation two months after the deadly attack on Minab Elementary School that killed more than 165 people. The comments were made in response to questions from Roe Kana, a California Democrat, who asked Haggett about the human costs and consequences of the attack. Haggett stressed that the incident could not be determined as a "disgraceful event". Last month, Haggett told reporters that an army general outside Central Command (CTC) was on duty to investigate the incident; however, he refused to answer questions about the cause of the attack and repeated that the U.S. official did not target civilians.
